title: The Best Celeb Vintage Fashion Moments Of The 2020s (So Far) - NewsBreak
text:
By Madison Emily Whisenand ,
5 hours ago
Zendaya smiling into the camera while wearing a strapless gown with matching teal eyeshadow Kevin Mazur/Getty Images Vintage fashion has proved to be a major element of the 2020s fashion landscape, with more and more celebs turning to collections of the past to make a statement on the red carpet. This style approach has many appeals, ranging from the flex associated with accessing archived items to the element of sustainability that comes with wearing vintage. Hollywood figures who walk the red carpet in archived pieces also position themselves as part of fashion history.
"Archival clothing holds not just moments in time but also the hours of creation — designers, teams, runway shows, and the personal collections they enter," Isabel Bonner, an archivist based in London, told Complex . "As these garments move into the archive phase, they continue to evolve through shoots, images, and red carpet moments, adding new layers to their story."
While this practice isn't always without controversy, see Kim Kardashian's wear of Marilyn Monroe's iconic birthday dress to the 2022 Met Gala, celebrities have proved that donning garments of the past can make for a real modern moment. Of course, some stars choose to wear recreations of classic pieces or take a more referential approach. With all this in mind, it's not surprising that some of the best fashion moments of the 2020s feature vintage.
Read more: The Full Gorgeous Transformation Of General Hospital's Kate Mansi
Olivia Rodrigo stunned in a tweed Chanel look back in 2021 Olivia Rodrigo wearing a plaid skirt suit and white platforms when visiting the White House in 2021 Chip Somodevilla/Getty Images Olivia Rodrigo landed on the list of best vintage fashion moments of the 2020s when she visited the White House back in 2021, meeting with President Joe Biden and Dr. Anthony Fauci to discuss the importance of vaccines. The "Drivers License" singer stepped out in a pink, white, and black tweed skirt suit from Chanel's Spring 1995 collection, pairing the chic set with a pair of platform heels, black socks, and black box handbag. The look balanced Rodrigo's youthful playfulness and the formality of the setting, being compared to Cher's iconic plaid look from "Clueless," alongside the pink-wearing Jackie Kennedy. In this way, the choice of vintage definitely paid off.
Bella Hadid looked like a work of art at the Cannes Film Festival Bella Hadid posing at the Cannes Film Festival with one hand on her shoulder and the other on her hip Mike Marsland/Getty Images In 2022, Bella Hadid attended a screening of "L'Innocent" at the Cannes Film Festival. The model looked absolutely beautiful in an archival dress featuring a strapless, ruched bodice and a velvet skirt dramatically draped with taffeta across the hips. The gown was originally designed by Gianni Versace for opera singer Helga Dernesch, with the Austrian donning the black gown for a performance of "Salomé at Teatro alla Scala" in 1987. Hadid styled the sculptural look with statement earrings, dramatic eyeliner, and a slicked back bun accented by a small bang. The celeb is no stranger to a vintage look, with this moment demonstrating the strength of her fashion prowess.
Gabrielle Union turned heads in a colorful vintage look at the NAACP Image Awards Gabrielle Union posing at the NAACP Image Awards while wearing a colorful, ankle-length dress from Versace Frazer Harrison/Getty Images Next, Gabrielle Union was dripping in color when she stepped out at the NAACP Image Awards in 2023. The "Bring It On" actor posed in an archival piece from Atelier Versace's fall 1989 collection known as the "Circus" gown that featured vibrant, geometric shapes said to be inspired by Cyrk Polish circus poster art. The hand-beaded garment also consisted of a strapless, structured bodice and an ankle-length skirt, with the model accessorizing with pointed-toed heels and a choker-style necklace with a triangular pendant. Not only did Union call back to a famous moment in Gianni Versace's design history, she looked absolutely stunning while doing so.
Zendaya wore a chic skirt suit when promoting Challengers in 2024 Zendaya posing at a "Challengers" photo call whiel wearing a striped Vivienne Westwood skirt suit with a feathered bustle Gareth Cattermole/Getty Images Given that Zendaya lands among celebrities who take method dressing to the next level , it comes as no surprise that one of her press tour ensembles doubles as a chic vintage moment. She attended a photo call for "Challengers"in a skirt suit from Vivienne Westwood's spring/summer 1994 "Café Society" collection. The two-piece set consisted of a vest-style top striped with shades of blue, red, and white, and a matching miniskirt equipped with a feathered bustle. The preppy look is one of many Zendaya has pulled from the archives, making her place on the list of best vintage moments of the 2020s well-earned.
Ariana Grande made her mark in a Chanel Haute Couture dress from 1986 Ariana Grande wearing a black dress with a ruffled, knee-length skirt to Variety's 0 Directors To Watch and Creative Impact Awards Kevin Winter/Getty Images Not only has Ariana Grande channeled Audrey Hepburn throughout her lookbook, she's donned actual archival garments to walk the red carpet. The "7 Rings" singer wore a vintage Chanel dress from the brand's fall 1986 collection to Variety's 10 Directors To Watch and Creative Impact Awards in 2025. The black dress consisted of a structured round skirt that fell below the knee and a zig-zag neckline adorned with a bow and white flower. The celeb kept her styling classic, donning pointed-toed heels, black tights, and a string of pearls. Clearly, Grande has an eye for vintage.
Chappell Roan had a major vintage moment at the 2025 Grammys Chappell Roan posing at the 2025 Grammy Awards while wearing a vintage-inspired Jean Paul Gaultier dress Axelle/bauer-griffin/Getty Images Chappel Roan made her debut at the Grammy Awards in 2025, walking the red carpet in a head-turning Jean Paul Gaultier dress from 2003. The archival gown featured a high-low skirt trimmed with lengths of tulle and decorated with an Edgar Degas-inspired print of twirling ballerinas. The "Good Luck, Babe!" artist paired the vintage piece with dramatic makeup reminiscent of a porcelain doll and cyan gloves tipped with golden nails. With Roan ranking among the best-dressed celebs of 2024 , it's not surprising that she continued to bring the drama with this vintage moment.
Natalie Portman was all vintage elegance at the 2025 Cannes Film Festival Natalie Portman wearing a sparkly gown inspired by Dior Fall 1951 Haute Couture at the Cannes Film Festival Andreas Rentz/Getty Images Next, Natalie Portman stepped out in a recreation of an iconic piece when attending the 2025 Cannes Film Festival. The floor-length dress was inspired by the "Mexique" gown from Dior's fall 1951 Haute Couture collection. It was designed with a silver strapless bodice tied with a black bow and an A-line skirt decorated with sparkly half-circles reminiscent of mermaid scales. The "Black Swan" star accessorized with dazzling diamond-encrusted jewelry and a slicked-back updo. While this is a recreation instead of an actual archival piece, it shines just as brightly as the original.
Keke Palmer wore a playful '90s look when attending the BET Awards Keke Palmer posing in a black minidress with golden sparkles at the BET Awards Emma Mcintyre/Getty Images Keke Palmer channeled '90s It-Girl at the 2025 BET Awards, walking the red carpet in a minidress from Chanel's fall/winter 1993 collection. The black piece featured a halter-style neckline and a statement tulle train, with gold sequins bringing a playful shine. The "Nope" actor kept her accessories simple, wearing shiny, pointed-toed heels and styling her hair into a middle-parted bob. Palmer has worn several archival looks throughout the 2020s, with this party-ready ensemble definitely being a standout for its fun energy.
